subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should this remain the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode report until live current-main reaction envelopes are captured, or should maintainers consolidate it under a broader Slack Socket Mode liveness investigation?
rationale: Source proves handler and filter boundaries, but not the live first-drop point; the choice depends on maintainer access to live Slack diagnostics and whether the broader open reports are the same failure.

options.title: Keep Reaction-Specific
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove Socket Mode report and require live redacted envelope/log proof before any code repair.

options.title: Consolidate Under Liveness
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode liveness cluster if maintainers can confirm reactions disappear only during zombie or stale websocket windows.

options.title: Request Fresh Reporter Data
options.body: Leave it open but mark it info-blocked until a reporter provides current-main logs, raw event metadata, and account/app identifiers with secrets redacted.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction-Specific
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove Socket Mode report and require live redacted envelope/log proof before any code repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The last merged reaction-routing fix and release provenance route most directly through this Slack system-event area.
